name: tpl-absence-2-nogoal
task: Don't drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task bans dropping the key while the door is still closed, and key_lost is defined exactly as 'the key was acquired and then lost before the door was opened', so the hard Absence(key_lost) captures the ban directly. key_lost is only restricted, never commanded, so the rule-only warning and empty FINAL_STATES are valid.

texts: Never lose the matching key before the door is opened.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, key_lost) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, key_lost, u1) -> -10
